title: CRD watering rules: lawn days, times and new sod

seo.title: CRD Watering Rules Explained: Lawn Days & Times
seo.description: A plain guide to CRD Stage 1 lawn watering days and times, new sod rules and setting an irrigation timer to match, with a link to the CRD source.

summary: A plain-language summary of the Capital Regional District's summer watering schedule for lawns, gardens and new sod.

body.p: Properties connected to a Capital Regional District (CRD) water system follow its summer watering rules. From May 1 to September 30, Stage 1 of the CRD Water Conservation Bylaw sets when lawns can be watered. Properties on private wells are not on the CRD schedule.

list: Times for any watering method: 4 am to 10 am, or 7 pm to 10 pm.
Timed or automatic irrigation: 12:01 am to 10 am, or 7 pm to 10 pm.
Multi-unit complexes, such as stratas, use the complex's street address, not each unit's number.

body.p: Under Stage 1, trees, shrubs and flower and vegetable gardens may be sprinkled on any day from 4 am to 10 am or 7 pm to 10 pm. Hand watering and drip irrigation are allowed any day, at any time. That is one reason we often convert beds from spray heads to drip.
New sod or seed does not need a permit and has its own temporary watering schedule. Check the CRD page for the current details before you lay new lawn.
In a dry year the CRD can move to a higher stage with tighter limits. Check the CRD site during summer for the current stage.

list: Set the lawn zones to your two allowed days and to start inside the allowed window.
Run several shorter cycles rather than one long one on slopes, so water soaks in instead of running off.
Set drip zones separately; they are not tied to lawn days under Stage 1.
Add a rain or soil-moisture sensor so the system skips wet days.

body.p: Need your system set up or adjusted? See [irrigation services](/services/irrigation/), our [spring checklist](/resources/spring-lawn-and-garden-checklist/) or [get a free quote](/quote/).
The CRD can change the stage or the schedule in a dry year. Check its watering page, linked below, before you set a controller. This summary was prepared in November 2026.
